name: Ingram Park Mall
summary: Ingram Park Mall is a classic enclosed regional shopping center featuring 150 stores, including major department store anchors, popular fashion chains, and a food court. Located on Northwest Loop 410, it serves as a primary shopping destination for northwest San Antonio.
demographics: Ingram Park Mall serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in northwest San Antonio, attracting families and young adults from surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area includes a mix of Hispanic and Anglo households with median incomes ranging from $45,000 to $75,000, representing a broad cross-section of San Antonio's growing population. Primary visitors are value-conscious shoppers seeking national brands and convenient one-stop shopping, with strong weekend traffic from families and teenagers. The center draws from a 10-15 mile radius encompassing established residential areas along Loop 410 and newer developments in the northwest corridor.
description: Ingram Park Mall stands as one of San Antonio's premier shopping destinations, serving the northwest side of the city since its opening. This classic enclosed regional mall features an impressive collection of 150 stores, offering shoppers a comprehensive retail experience under one roof. The center is anchored by major department stores and includes a diverse mix of popular fashion chains, specialty retailers, and a bustling food court that caters to every taste. With its convenient location at 6301 Northwest Loop 410, the mall provides easy access for residents throughout the northwest San Antonio area and beyond. The shopping center has maintained its position as a community gathering place, combining traditional mall amenities with modern retail offerings to serve generations of San Antonio families.
